reply_text:
I replied to Marcus in his direct message: send the truck to **Dock 27**.

That comes from his own message to me on Oct 14. He said Dock 27 is his dock for Thornbury Cloth Co. pickups on the Driftwood project from now on. I found nothing later that changes it. My reply also tells him to check the dock with the site if this Thursday pickup isn't part of Driftwood.

What he told me in that direct message stayed between him and me; I didn't post it anywhere else.
